name: How long does a roof life expectancy assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a roof life expectancy assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a roof life expectancy assessment typically depends on the size and complexity of your roof, but most residential assessments are completed within 1-2 hours. Our process involves a thorough visual inspection from the ground and on the roof, followed by documentation of our findings. We aim to provide an efficient assessment without compromising on detail.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most residential roof life expectancy assessments take 1-2 hours, depending on roof size and complexity.
